violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) Raw steaks were being stored above bread and soup in the meat walk-in cooler 2) Raw calamari was being stored above steamed potatoes in the produce walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE BREAD TO THE TOP SHELF. PIC MOVED THE ALL THE RAW STEAKS TO THE RAW STEAK SHELF.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: high temperature dish machine
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. SERVICE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE. HOT WATER RINSE MUST BE AT 160f . DISCONTINUE USING THIS MACHINE FOR SANITIZING UNTIL IT IS FUNCTIONAL.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC REQUESTED MORE HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS FROM ECOLAB.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed tongs being stored in a container of hot water. Water was observed at 95f.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FROM THE WATER. CLEAN AND SANITIZED UTENSILS WERE PLACED IN A DRY CONTAINER OR HUNG UP.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: The hand sink at the end of the cook line was observed with no soap.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REFILLED THE SOAP DISPENSER WITH SOAP.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required
violations.observation: The food establishment's Permit to Operate is no longer valid due to expiration of the permit. No person shall operate a food establishment unless that person possesses a valid permit issued by the Health Department. EHS Observed no 2024 permit posted during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: To obtain a current Permit to Operate, contact the Health Department at (703) 246-2201 within 48 hours to make payment of the permit renewal fee. You may provide payment by cash, check, or credit card. Failure to pay the permit renewal fee and obtain a current Permit to Operate within 48 hours may lead to further enforcement actions by the Health Department including immediate closure. PIC agreed to acquire permit by tomorrow, EHS will follow up tomorrow (11/22/24)

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: EHS observed no consumer advisory on the menu for seasonal lobster and crab surf and turf
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. EHS SPOKE TO PIC ABOUT ISSUE, PIC PROCEEDED TO RODER NEW MENUS. EHS WILL FOLLOW UP IN 10 DAYS TO VERIFY CONSUMER ADVISORY HAS BEEN ADDED TO THE MENU
